notes: Only assigned replication n and effect-size fields were targeted. Original and reported-success entries are unassigned placeholders. Target identified by Experiment 3 and reaction-time outcome/comparison, independently of input row order. Locator p. 13 corresponds to PDF page 13 / printed p. 12. Printed dz is retained without conversion to unspecified d. Same-test p is retained with its printed bound. The source gives 62 contributors (31 per encoding group) and two participant exclusions from all LDT analyses, but no explicit final participant N for the pooled speed contrasts or final encoding-group counts. The mixed ANOVA prints F(1, 58) / F(2, 116), whereas the paired contrasts print t(58). These do not consistently establish one analytic N. Recruitment is not substituted for analytic N and N is not inferred from df. Candidate only: 62 recruitment participants - 2 explicitly described LDT exclusions = 60; not entered as analytic N. No mutually exclusive final analytic-group counts are printed. Paired t(58) is retained as printed, not used to derive N. Trial removal (7.14%) is a different counting role. PDF pages 12, 13, and 20 visually inspected; table 2 gives means/SDs but no final analytic group counts.
